Price drift: a POTD only has to be in band at selection. Later moves of any size never void it. Void only for inactive player or postponed/cancelled game.
A provisional pick that is out of band before lock with no in-band replacement is marked "On hold" and re-checked at lock. It still never voids for drift.
Today POTD = single best, most-favored play across all sports on the slate.

POTD auto-chain: when a sport's POTD settles, staged pick posts as "POTD #n" (official, locked). Candidates are B or better, pregame, ≥10 min to start, not a game already used by the chain, in band, final live Hard Rock check. Nothing qualifies → nothing posts. All Sports POTD does NOT chain. The newest chain pick shows alone in the card.
MLB locks at lineup lock (pre-lock colors red/yellow/green). Others lock when posted.

Code enforces the range: the bot prices legs only inside -500..+120, and the bot refuses to build (PRICE RANGE ERROR) on any out-of-range Parlay +100 leg in the newest the bot, which covers the agent-built "Daily +105 parlay picks" ticket.
Chain: a parlay that settles (L as soon as any leg loses) is followed by "Parlay +100 #n" at total +100..+125, using no game from an earlier parlay that day. The All Sports (Big 4) parlay chains too.
Same-game rule: legs normally come from different games. When only ONE game is on the slate or left, the ticket is built as a same-game parlay PREGAME.
All Sports parlay: safest 2-4 legs, about +100 to +115 (unofficial in All-sports mode).
